reasoning: The universal three-arc symbol for Wi-Fi and wireless internet connectivity. It is immediately recognizable and fits a common family of household, tech, bill-paying, and travel tasks around internet service and wireless networks, though it should not be used when 'wireless' is merely an adjective on another device like headphones or a mouse.

pass1.ambiguity: Can occasionally be confused with an RSS feed icon (which normally radiates from a bottom-left corner rather than bottom-center) or generic contactless/NFC waves.
